description: This PHP source file defines a class for managing VAST overlay banners in an advertising system, including form building, file uploads, and overlay configuration.

classes.name: Plugins_BannerTypeHTML_vastOverlayBannerTypeHtml_vastOverlayHtml
classes.description: Class for handling VAST overlay HTML banners, including form creation, overlay configuration, and file uploads.

methods.name: getBannerShortName
methods.description: Returns the short name of the banner type, 'Overlay Video Ad'.

methods.name: getZoneToLinkShortName
methods.description: Returns the banner short name for zone linking.

methods.name: getHelpAdTypeDescription
methods.description: Provides a description of the overlay video ad type.

methods.name: getOptionDescription
methods.description: Returns a description for dropdown selection, translated.

methods.name: preprocessForm
methods.description: Preprocesses form data, including handling new uploaded files.

methods.name: addVastOverlayFormatsRadioButton
methods.description: Adds radio buttons to select overlay format (Image, Text, HTML) to the form.

methods.name: addVastOverlayActionRadioButton
methods.description: Adds radio buttons for overlay click actions (Open page or Play video).

methods.name: addVastOverlayAsHtml
methods.description: Adds HTML input elements for overlay HTML content.

methods.name: addVastOverlayAsText
methods.description: Adds text input elements for overlay text content.

methods.name: addVastOverlayAsImage
methods.description: Adds image upload elements for overlay images.

methods.name: addVastFileUploadGroup
methods.description: Handles file upload group creation for overlay images.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the overlay banner configuration form with various input elements.

methods.name: getFieldLabel
methods.description: Returns label for a given form field.

methods.name: processNewUploadedFile
methods.description: Processes uploaded overlay image files, storing file details and updating banner fields.
